question: For which of the following microorganisms is an effective vaccine available ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Haemophilus influenzae serogroup B -> Vaccine development -> Effective vaccine available -> 95% CHAIN: Neisseria gonorrhoeae -> Vaccine research ongoing -> Unclear effectiveness of available vaccine -> 95%
analysis: Vaccines are available for Haemophilus influenzae serogroup B, which is a common cause of bacterial meningitis and other serious infections, making option d the correct choice.
